notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
description:
Cast Incarnation Technique by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Incarnation Technique.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Incarnation Technique, with the copy targeting Naru Meha
Resolve the Incarnation Technique copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
